pages.vextreme-youtube.hero.lede.text: A living production archive for videos that emerge from the work. Each episode begins as a walk, becomes a production record, and returns here after publication with the finished video and the context that made it.

pages.vextreme-youtube.lifecycle.title.text: The record grows with the episode.

pages.vextreme-youtube.lifecycle.walk.text: Walk — begin with what Victor actually wants to express now. Do not force a questionnaire or production checklist over the conversation.

pages.vextreme-youtube.lifecycle.shape.text: Shape — as the walk reveals a real episode, preserve the story, demonstrations, phrases, visual moments, and editing needs that genuinely emerged.

pages.vextreme-youtube.lifecycle.publish.text: Publish — title, thumbnail, description, chapters, final edit, and YouTube publication belong after the episode has enough shape to support them.

pages.vextreme-youtube.lifecycle.return.text: Return — embed the published video back into its Vextreme record beside the transcript, demonstrated artifacts, source links, and the next natural edge.

pages.vextreme-youtube.first.body.text: This starts as a walk surface, not a finished template. The reusable template should be distilled from an episode that actually emerged, then refined only when repeated production experience earns another pattern.

pages.vextreme-youtube.closing.text: A YouTube upload is one manifestation. The durable record stays in Vextreme.

pages.vextreme-youtube.current.body.text: The first full story spine has emerged: VexLife, why it exists, current proof, VexBoard, Victor’s present situation, the God layer, Burden Release, and what comes next. This is a working walk, not a locked script.
